attributes.name: Potty Mastery - How to adapt it to your child

product.description_html:
Potty Mastery - Is this course for me?

  • If your child is 12 months and up
  • If you are wondering whether your toddler is ready to start potty learning
  • If you think your child may be ready, but you find the information out there confusing
  • If you are unsure of how to start or you are stuck trying to teach your child to use the potty
  • If you would like to learn a method that is respectful AND that prioritises learning about their body
  • If you want a method without rewards (or punishments)
  • If you've tried a different method of potty training but it didn't work
  • If you have a toddler who is withholding wee or poo
  • If you would like practical tips to deal with fear or resistance to use the potty (again, no rewards or bribing here either)
  • If you would like to approach potty learning differently and maybe even have fun....!
  • If you're looking for a method that is not authoritarian but respects your needs too, then this course is for you.

This course will help you decide when to start, how to prepare, how to start and what you need to buy (or not buy).

You will get a 1.5 hour video course (around 85 mins) broken down into manageable chunks, as well as a 10-page PDF handbook with more tips and ideas. You will have life-time access to watch the class as many times as you need.

The course includes everything you need to start the learning process and transition out of nappies, supporting your child to learn about their body.

There is also the option of booking a troubleshooting consultation at a reduced price. This bundle is ideal if you're feeling stuck or if you tried a method that didn't work or you're experiencing refusal to poo anywhere but in a nappy, so we can delve deeper into what's going on for your child.

In December 2020 I did your potty training course when my eldest daughter was 30 months old, I felt I had been given very inconsistent and, in retrospect, incorrect advice from the health visitors and as a result potty training seemed extremely daunting.

However your course gave me the confidence we needed and we started right away. Despite always being very hesitant with potty training when we’ve tried before, this time my daughter just got it straight away and we never looked back.

I kept everything I’d learnt from your course in my mind and approached potty training with my youngest daughter in a totally different way. It was very gradual and all felt very natural. (...) at 19 months we took the plunge and she has been dry in the day ever since.

To have been able to do it when she was nearly a year younger than her sister was such a achievement for us and I would never had had the confidence were it not for doing your course. Jess, mum of 2

options.name: Potty Mastery Class
options.description: The whole pre-recorded class (7 videos = 70 mins) to learn at your own pace and a PDF handbook with a summary of the method and extra tips and phrases to use.

options.name: Potty Training Class + Consultation
options.description: Get all the videos and the handbook, plus a 30-min Zoom consultation with me to go through any issues you foresee or are already troubleshooting. Ideal if want to ask a couple of questions or focus on one issue.

options.name: Potty Mastery + Let me hold your hand
options.description: You get all of the above (class, handout & consultation) plus 2 weeks of Voxer support (via 5-min daily voice messages). So you can get in touch every day for 2 weeks and you'll receive a recorded voice message, ideal if you want me there along the way
